opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applications must be supported by a Society Representative or a Fellow.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to postdoctoral researchers who are members of the Society.
opportunities.summary: Supports postdoctoral researchers requiring additional support to achieve their full potential, covering consumables, registration for fellowships, and other justified sundries.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct publishable educational research addressing key questions in physiological education.
opportunities.summary: Supports development of educational resources or research in physiological education.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award
opportunities.eligibility_summary: For members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop new techniques, or finalize projects, and support knowledge transfer and impact activities.
opportunities.summary: Supports pilot studies, technique development, project finalisation, and knowledge exchange activities.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate & Masters, Postgraduate, Full member or Fellow of the Society in their second year of membership or longer.
opportunities.summary: Provides support for members to run activities that address equity, diversity, and inclusion principles.
